title: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 70.1) about mathematics: 60 1. Counting to itself 26 times. Or quicker: there are 26 · 26 choices for the first two letters. Now for each choice
prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 70.1) about mathematics: 60 1. Counting to itself 26 times. Or quicker: there are 26 · 26 choices for the first two letters. Now for each choice
true_answer: 60 1. Counting to itself 26 times. Or quicker: there are 26 · 26 choices for the first two letters. Now for each choice of the first two letters, we have 26 choices for the third letter. That is, 26 third letters for the first two letters AA, 26 choices for the third letter after starting AB, and so on. There are 26 · 26 of these 26 third letter choices, for a total of ( 26 · 26 )· 26 choices for the first three letters. And for each of these 26 · 26 · 26 choices of letters, we have a bunch of choices for the remaining digits.
